messages.message:
The calibration certificate for the balance on order NI-2045 shows as Issued. This means it was generated and should have been emailed within five working days of dispatch, but I cannot confirm actual email delivery or the date.

If you cannot find the certificate, you can request a free reissue within 12 months of the calibration date. Please email calibration@northaven-instruments.example with your order reference and the instrument serial number. This is a fictional address for demonstration.

Would you like help with a recalibration quote or anything else?
